items.title: Mark Soskin interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, September 17, 2021
items.q: And right after I auditioned Sonny goes, “Okay, you got the gig and we’re going to rehearse in a day or so” and that’s that.

ctx.x: Have you ever had a student go to one of those things and come in the next day and say oh, I really blew it?

That can happen. That can definitely happen. I mean look, when I first got the call to do Sonny’s, come down to Fantasy Records and do this audition. An “audition” it was called. When I got to the studio, at 12 midnight, there was nobody there except Orrin and Sonny. That’s it. What am I going to do? I have to play? You know this is like I could get the gig. So you know you really have to just make the most of it. You know and I knew at the time that this was a big thing. And so when I went to do the audition I…
had to be ready for this. I mean I was a lot younger then you know, and I really had to take care of business immediately.
